title: hamiltonians-flow-portrait widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §2 Hamiltonian flow portrait on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic — the signature phase-space-portrait gesture: pick a Hamiltonian from a <select>, see the vector field rendered into the SVG, and click anywhere in the field to drop an initial condition that integrates forward under the flow. The combination of select + click-on-SVG + step/clear buttons + a hint <span class='small'> trailing the buttons does not fit any shared slug; this slug captures it as a single unit.

ariaLabel.description: aria-label on <svg>; source uses aria-label rather than a <title> child.

pick.description: Hamiltonian-family chooser <select>, rendered alone in its own .row.

buttons.description: Action buttons rendered in the .row beneath the SVG.

buttonsTrailing.description: Inline HTML appended to the same .row as `buttons` — typically a `…` carrying the click-affordance hint.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ banner placed between the leading <script> tag and the IIFE opener.

bodyScript.x-artifact: script body is bespoke; portable consumers should implement their own field/trajectory logic from {pick.options, buttons} alone
bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Verbatim JS statements that go inside `(function(){\n…\n})();` — wires the select, the click handler, the step/clear buttons, and the field/trajectory draw calls.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget">. Required by the corpus-wide test-widget-renderers convention.
